snippet.title: Manala: Equinox War | LARP deckbuilder scenery trailer
snippet.description:
Manala is a videogame about live-action roleplaying (LARP). It is based on a real LARP event that takes place in a real location in Estonia. This trailer shows the few square kilometers of the battlefield, as well as the wider areas surrounding it. 

🛒 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4898080/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=pinned&utm_campaign=demo_launch&utm_content=scenerytrailer
🎮 Free demo: out now

Music: "Achaidh Cheide" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0 · Aerial photos and terrain: Maa- ja Ruumiamet · Earth: NASA Blue Marble · Border: © OpenStreetMap contributors · Satellite: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2017), CC BY 4.0.
